status: design specification; not an implemented renderer

profiles.name: Coach’s Cut
profiles.intent: Turn a match or lesson into evidence-linked instruction.

editing.cutPolicy: at point boundaries; within-rally cuts only for a reviewed demonstration
editing.replay: original speed first; optional labelled slow motion; no synthetic intermediate frames by default
editing.effects: arrows and freeze frames outside the original-speed keeper

mustNot: replace a coach observation with a fabricated measurement
profiles.fallback: Use user notes and manually chosen clips when automatic observations are unavailable.

profiles.name: Match Broadcast
profiles.intent: Make a clean, understandable television-style record of the match.

editing.cutPolicy: stay on selected wide angle during play; replays and alternate views after point end
editing.effects: quiet transitions and restrained lower thirds

mustNot: present a flat movie as interactive multi-angle replay
profiles.fallback: A complete one-angle match with chapter markers.

profiles.name: Rally Pulse
profiles.intent: Create an energetic highlight film without losing the point’s meaning.

editing.cutPolicy: keep the selected rally sequence intact; energy cuts between points
editing.pace: quick between rallies, clear during live action
editing.effects: optional beat-aligned cuts, title accents and brief transitions; shake off by default; clean alternate version
editing.music: user-selected licensed track or court sound

mustNot: flash or shake over contact frames

profiles.name: Progress Story
profiles.intent: Show a player’s learning across dated sessions and lessons.
mustNot: mix incompatible measurement methods without warning
claim a causal improvement from two clips
select only successes while implying a complete statistic
profiles.fallback: A lesson chronology with user-authored reflections and no improvement metric.

profiles.name: Court Memories
profiles.intent: Memorialize the people, place and experience of a day on court.

editing.cutPolicy: real source moments and identifiable source-linked B-roll
editing.effects: gentle transitions, warm consistent grade, natural sound

mustNot: make a generated moment appear to be match footage
profiles.fallback: One-camera match excerpts with real stills and original audio.
